game_concept: A racing platformer set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the pass gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the pass gate. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the mountaineer ahead. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the pass gate by solving code steps involving vault_keys that move the mountaineer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the pass gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
